item.text: {"case_id":"SHC061","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C23","C04","C19"],"selected_candidate_label":"C23","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C23 is a compelling material drafting template. The child closely reproduces C23's distinctive sequence and language: an expanded series of Antiquities Act findings; proclamation and withdrawal; management by a military-associated land manager in consultation with Interior; management-plan rulemaking, maximum public involvement, and final authority; protection of sacred sites and specified gathering rights; meaningful Tribal engagement based on Indigenous Knowledge; infrastructure and valid-rights savings clauses; munitions-remediation provisions; military-overflight language; dominant-reservation warning; and severability. These extensive parallels go well beyond routine national-monument boilerplate. C04 and C19 share several management, Tribal, infrastructure, and military clauses, but neither matches the child's overall machinery as closely as C23.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Whereas, I find that each of the objects identified above ... are objects of historic or scientific interest in need of protection ... Whereas, I find that the boundaries ... represent the smallest area compatible","explanation":"The child adopts C23's unusually elaborate, ordered series of presidential findings rather than merely the standard Antiquities Act recital."},{"child_excerpt":"The Secretary shall prepare, in consultation with the Secretary of the Interior, a management plan ... and shall promulgate such regulations ... The final decision over any management plan and regulations rests with the Secretary.","parent_excerpt":"The Secretary shall prepare, in consultation with the Secretary of the Interior, a management plan ... and shall promulgate such regulations ... The Secretary shall provide for maximum public involvement ... The final decision over any management plans and any management rules and regulations rests with the Secretary.","explanation":"This is nearly verbatim management machinery, adapted from the Secretary of Agriculture to the Secretary of the Army and supplemented for Castner Range remediation."},{"child_excerpt":"The Secretary shall, to the maximum extent permitted by law and in consultation with Tribal Nations, ensure the protection of sacred sites and traditional cultural properties and sites ... including collection of medicines, berries and other vegetation, forest products, and firewood for personal non-commercial use","parent_excerpt":"The Secretary shall, to the maximum extent permitted by law and in consultation with Tribal Nations, ensure the protection of sacred sites and traditional cultural properties and sites ... including collection of medicines, berries and other vegetation, forest products, and firewood for personal noncommercial use","explanation":"The sacred-site protection and detailed gathering-rights clause is essentially reproduced."},{"child_excerpt":"In recognition of the importance of these lands and objects to Tribal Nations, and to ensure that management decisions affecting the monument reflect Tribal expertise and Indigenous Knowledge, the Secretary shall meaningfully engage with Tribal Nations ...","parent_excerpt":"In recognition of the importance of these lands and objects to Tribal Nations, and to ensure that management decisions affecting the monument reflect Tribal expertise and Indigenous Knowledge, the Secretary shall meaningfully engage with Tribal Nations ...","explanation":"This distinctive Tribal-engagement sentence is copied almost word for word."},{"child_excerpt":"Nothing in this proclamation shall affect the responsibilities and authorities of the Department of Defense under applicable environmental laws within the monument boundaries. Nothing ... shall affect the Secretary's ability to authorize access to and remediation of contaminated lands","parent_excerpt":"Nothing in this proclamation shall affect the responsibilities and authorities of the Department of Defense under applicable environmental laws for the remediation of hazardous substances or munitions or explosives of concern within the monument boundaries ... Nothing ... shall affect the Forest Service's ability to authorize access to and remediation of contaminated lands","explanation":"The child adapts C23's specialized military-contamination and remediation savings provisions to an Army-managed former firing range."},{"child_excerpt":"If any provision of this proclamation, including application to a particular parcel of land, is held to be invalid, the remainder ... and its application to other parcels of land shall not be affected thereby.","parent_excerpt":"If any provision of this proclamation, including its application to a particular parcel of land, is held to be invalid, the remainder ... and its application to other parcels of land shall not be affected thereby.","explanation":"The same severability clause closes both proclamations, reinforcing the broader drafting relationship."}]}
